tagline.zh: 普通人工作记忆大约只能保持 7±2 项。对策是把内容分块(chunking),但「神奇数字七」不能为不必要的设计限制辩护。
tagline.en: The average person keeps about 7±2 items in working memory. The fix is chunking — but the 'magical number seven' must not justify unnecessary design limitations.

origin.zh: 1956 年 George Miller 提出:即刻记忆与绝对判断的容量都限制在 7 左右(Jon Yablonski,Laws of UX;调研 07§24)。配套 Chunking 法则:分块让内容可扫读、层级分组帮助理解关系(调研 07§24)。
origin.en: In 1956 George Miller asserted that immediate memory and absolute judgment are both limited to around 7 pieces of information (Jon Yablonski, Laws of UX; research 07 §24). Its companion law, Chunking: breaking content into chunks makes it scannable and hierarchical grouping clarifies relationships (research 07 §24).

effect.zh: 每轮呈现的随机数字个数。默认 10:略超 7±2 上界,不分组时大多数人会漏 1–3 个——正是定律的体感区间;4 与 14 分别给出「轻松」与「必败」两端。
effect.en: Random digits shown per round. Default 10: just above the 7±2 ceiling, so unchunked recall typically drops 1–3 digits — the felt range of the law; 4 and 14 give the 'easy' and 'hopeless' ends.

effect.zh: 分块大小;0 = 不分组。默认 3:与「电话号码按 3–4 位分组」同构,10 位数字分 4 块,工作记忆只需持 4 项。0 与 digits 对比即 chunking 的效果。
effect.en: Chunk size; 0 = unchunked. Default 3: isomorphic to phone numbers grouped in 3–4 digit blocks — 10 digits become 4 items for working memory. Compare chunk=0 vs chunk=3 to feel chunking.

note.zh: 演示为纯 DOM/输入框交互,全现代浏览器可用。
note.en: Pure DOM/input interaction; all modern browsers.

fallback.zh: 工作记忆超载没有 CSS 回退,工程出口是**把内容切小**:超长表单拆步、设置项分组、复杂流程渐进披露;分组边界要同时用间距与容器(共同区域)表达,别让「凑成 7 项」变成砍功能的借口。
fallback.en: Working-memory overload has no CSS fallback; the engineering exit is **cutting content smaller**: split long forms into steps, group settings, disclose progressively. Express group boundaries with both spacing and containers (common region) — and never let 'fit it into 7' become an excuse to cut features.

use.zh: 电话号/卡号/序列号输入框按 3–4 位分块显示
use.en: Phone/card/serial inputs displayed in 3–4 digit chunks

use.zh: 导航与设置页分组(每组 3–7 项),而非 20 项平铺
use.en: Nav and settings grouped into 3–7 item sections instead of a flat 20

use.zh: 把长流程拆成「每步只记 1–2 件事」的向导
use.en: Wizards that ask you to remember 1–2 things per step

avoid.zh: 拿 7±2 当「只能放 7 个导航项」的教条——lawsofux 原文告诫:不要为不必要的设计限制辩护
avoid.en: Using 7±2 as a 'only 7 nav items' dogma — the Laws of UX caveat: never justify unnecessary design limitations with it

avoid.zh: 同一屏幕塞 10+ 个平权且无分块的输入项
avoid.en: 10+ flat, unchunked, equal-weight inputs on one screen

a11y.zh: 分块不能丢语义:视觉上分组的信息必须同样用语义分组(fieldset/legend、列表、标题层级)传达给读屏(WCAG SC 1.3.1 信息与关系)。演示的回忆输入用 label 关联,数字串不做自动消失的「闪现内容」——超时展示由用户主动触发重看。
a11y.en: Chunking must not lose semantics: visually grouped information must be grouped semantically too (fieldset/legend, lists, heading hierarchy) for screen readers (WCAG SC 1.3.1). The demo's recall input is label-associated, and the digit string never vanishes without user control — re-display is user-triggered.

goal.zh: 做一个工作记忆分块实验:随机数字串按可调块长显示 3 秒后隐藏,用户凭记忆输入,按位计分;对比 chunk=0 与 chunk=3 的回忆率,体感 7±2 与 chunking。
goal.en: Build a working-memory chunking experiment: a random digit string displayed for 3s at an adjustable chunk size, then hidden; the user recalls by typing and scores per position; compare recall at chunk=0 vs chunk=3 to feel 7±2 and chunking.

acceptance.zh: 数字个数与块长严格使用参数快照值(digits 默认 10,chunk 默认 3,0=不分组)
acceptance.en: Digit count and chunk size use the exact parameter snapshot (digits default 10, chunk default 3, 0 = unchunked)

acceptance.zh: 展示 3 秒后隐藏;回忆输入框自动聚焦并带 label
acceptance.en: Hide after 3s; the recall input auto-focuses with a label

acceptance.zh: 按位计分并显示正确率,结果可累计多轮对比
acceptance.en: Score per position with an accuracy readout; rounds accumulate for comparison

acceptance.zh: 「重看一次」由按钮触发,不自动重播
注意屏阅读:分组用语义列表,不只靠空格
acceptance.en: Screen-reader safe: grouping uses semantic lists, not just spaces
